newsitem.title: FRANCE: Haiti's Aristide gets UNESCO human rights prize.
newsitem.headline: Haiti's Aristide gets UNESCO human rights prize.

text.p: UNESCO said on Monday it has awarded Haiti's ex-president Jean-Bertrand Aristide its prize for human rights education for his "exceptional engagement in favour of human rights and democracy" in his Caribbean country.
Aristide, elected in 1990, was ousted in a coup in 1991 and returned to power three years later following a U.S. military intervention.
Elected President Rene Preval took over from Aristide in 1996 in Haiti's first democratic handover.

The United Nations Educational Scientific and Cultural Organisation said the award, to be presented at its Paris headquarters on January 8, would encourage Aristide to pursue his action through his Aristide Foundation for Democracy.
